hub.what_it_was: Team Ico was the group around Fumito Ueda behind ICO and Shadow of the Colossus; it presented their PS3 collection in 2010. Its later game, The Last Guardian, came to PlayStation 4, and Shadow of the Colossus was remade for PS4 with Bluepoint. Sony re-centred Japan Studio on Team Asobi on April 1, 2021.
hub.what_survives: The engine and production material are not public, and rights are restricted. Only official PlayStation pages, interviews and reorganization reporting are public.
hub.years: unknown; Japan Studio was reorganized in 2021
